title: "Development and deployment commands"
format: html

## Project layout

- `services/brdr-api`: FastAPI service and API tests.
- `apps/brdr-viewers`: React/Vite host viewers, GeoLifecycleManager and BRDR MFE's.
- `mapstore/`: optional, locally ignored MapStore demo and BRDR plugin (available only in a local checkout where it has been installed).
- `deploy/azure`: Azure build, push, deploy and ACI refresh helpers.

## Build and test

Build the viewers:

```powershell
cd apps/brdr-viewers
npm ci
npm run build
```

Run the API tests:

```powershell
cd services/brdr-api
..\..\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
```

Build the single Docker image used by the current deployment flow:

```powershell
docker build -f Dockerfile . -t brdr-webservice
```

Build the MapStore demo bundle:

```powershell
cd mapstore/demo
npm run compile
npm run verify:demo
```

## Local Docker demo

From the `mapstore` folder:

```powershell
docker compose up --build
```

This starts the BRDR service on port `8000` and the MapStore demo on port
`8081`.

## Azure helpers

The scripts in `deploy/azure/` are optional PowerShell/CMD wrappers:

- `az-acr-build-push`: build and push with Azure Container Registry Build.
- `az-acr-local-build-push`: local Docker build and push.
- `az-deploy`: deploy the configured single image to Web App or Container Apps.
- `az-aci-refresh-latest`: recreate an existing ACI group with the latest image.

Copy `deploy/azure/azure-deploy.settings.ps1.example` to
`deploy/azure/azure-deploy.settings.ps1`, fill in the Azure values, and run the desired
wrapper from the repository root, for example:

```powershell
.\deploy\azure\az-deploy.ps1 -Target webapp -SettingsFile .\deploy\azure\azure-deploy.settings.ps1
```
